provenance: A DRY RUN OF THE PROMPT, NOT AN API MEASUREMENT. Produced by applying server/prompts/policy-v1.mjs to policy.txt by hand while building phase 5, because this container has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Kept deliberately as the corpus's hard case: the page reached from cnil.fr is a data-protection landing page with a full cookie table but no article-13 notice of its own — most subjects are genuinely absent from THIS document, and a reader who assumed the CNIL's own site must score well would have marked them present. `npm run verify:policies -- --live` is the real measurement.

mentions.subject: identity_controller
mentions.quote: La CNIL s'engage à ce que les traitements de données personnelles effectués sur cnil.fr soient conformes au règlement général sur la protection des données (RGPD) et à la loi Informatique et Libertés.
mentions.note: The controller is named only in passing; the page describes what each online service discloses rather than making the disclosure itself.

mentions.subject: contact_dpo
mentions.quote: A l'attention du délégué à la protection des données (DPO)
mentions.note: With a postal address and a contact form.

mentions.subject: data_categories
mentions.note: The page says each service states its categories; it states none itself.

mentions.subject: purposes
mentions.quote: Nous utilisons différents traceurs/cookies sur le site pour mesurer l’audience et intégrer des services permettant d’améliorer l’interactivité du site.
mentions.note: Stated for cookies only; for everything else the page defers to each service's own notice.

mentions.subject: legal_bases
mentions.note: Listed as something each service's notice provides, not given here.

mentions.subject: recipients
mentions.quote: les destinataires des données (uniquement la CNIL en principe, sauf précision lorsqu'une transmission à un tiers est nécessaire) ;
mentions.note: Part of a list of what each service's own notice must contain, rather than a disclosure for this site.

mentions.subject: third_country_transfers
mentions.note: Named as something services disclose where it applies; nothing is disclosed here.

mentions.subject: retention
mentions.note: A period is given for each cookie in the table, and for nothing else.

mentions.subject: rights_access_rectify_erase
mentions.quote: Pour toute information ou exercice de vos droits Informatique et Libertés sur les traitements de données personnelles gérés par la CNIL, vous pouvez contacter son délégué à la protection des données (DPO)
mentions.note: How to exercise the rights, without listing which rights they are.

mentions.subject: right_withdraw_consent
mentions.quote: vous avez la possibilité de vous opposer à l’utilisation des traceurs de mesure d’audience strictement nécessaires au fonctionnement et aux opérations d’administration courante du site web dans la fenêtre de gestion des cookies située en haut à droite de chaque page du site.
mentions.note: A right to object to measurement trackers; withdrawal of consent as such is not stated.

mentions.subject: right_complain_supervisory
mentions.note: The site is the supervisory authority, which does not remove the requirement to say so.

mentions.subject: cookies_described
mentions.quote: Types de traceurs/cookies déposés sur le site de la CNIL :
mentions.note: Followed by a table giving each cookie, its purpose and its lifetime.

mentions.subject: consent_withdrawal_mechanism
mentions.quote: dans la fenêtre de gestion des cookies située en haut à droite de chaque page du site
